summary: This class added several rough logistics around the upcoming exam, Task 3, and reassessments. The instructor said the exam is in two weeks (around 2026-01-22), will be short questions/answers, and will cover genome variation, regulation of gene expression, and proteins; the course page lists a Jan 19 partial exam and does not describe exam content. Task 3 was said to be due around 2026-01-22, one or two days before the exam, whereas the course page says 2026-01-20. Reassessment was said to be in three to four weeks (2026-01-29 to 2026-02-05) for exams scored below 5, whereas the course page lists Jan 26.

items.title: Upcoming exam date
items.details: Teacher says the exam is 'in two weeks' from the 8 January 2026 class, i.e. around 2026-01-22, and that Task 3 is due one or two days before it. The course page lists Partial Exam 4 on 2026-01-19, so the stated date differs by about three days.

items.title: Exam format and content
items.details: Teacher says the exam will consist of short questions with expected short answers, similar to the last exam. It will include genome variation, regulation of gene expression, and proteins; she will send a message with the exact contents.

items.title: Task 3 deadline
items.details: Teacher says Task 3 is due 'in two weeks' from 8 January 2026, around 2026-01-22, and is due one or two days before the exam. The course page lists Task 3 due on 2026-01-20.

items.title: Reassessment exams
items.details: Teacher says in three or four weeks (between 2026-01-29 and 2026-02-05) students can reassess exams they failed, specifically retake exams where they did not obtain a minimum of 5. The course page lists reassessment for Partial Exams 1 and 4 on 2026-01-26.

items.title: Last class
items.details: Teacher states that the 8 January 2026 session is the last class for the biomedicine for engineers course.

items.title: Questions and tutoring
items.details: Teacher says students can contact her by email or request a tutoring session if they have questions about the course or exam.
